title: Beyond the Trees Avondale: Treetop Walk & Tower
summary: 1.4km treetop walk, 38m viewing tower with slide, house tours, and café in Rathdrum.
description: Beyond the Trees Avondale reopened in June 2022 following a €19 million redevelopment project by Coillte in partnership with Fáilte Ireland and EAK Ireland. Located in Rathdrum, the site features the longest Treetop Walk in Ireland and the UK, stretching 1.4km. This journey through and above the trees culminates at the impressive Viewing Tower, which stands 38m above the forest. From here, visitors reveal panoramic 360-degree views over the Wicklow Mountains, the Avonmore River, and the Vale of Avoca. Both adults and children can opt to whizz back down the tower via the gigantic 90m spiral slide. The venue also offers a complimentary self-guided visit to the Coillte Pavilion, where visitors learn about the evolution of forestry in Ireland. Adjacent to the outdoor dining terrace of the Seed Café is an adventurous children's playground within the picturesque Walled Garden. The café crafts creative food offerings using high quality, local Wicklow ingredients. Guided tours of the historic 18th century Avondale House, titled 'At Home with the Parnells', are available to book in advance from Autumn 2022. These tours encompass the life and times of Charles Stewart Parnell, his mother Delia, and his sisters Fanny and Anna, who were co-founders of the Ladies Land League in 1881. From the Walled Gardens, there is access to the Treetop Walk, a stimulating sensory garden, and forest walking trails.

title: Lough Key Forest & Activity Park
summary: Forest park in Boyle with trails, picnic areas, BBQs, and paid activities like Boda Borg and Zipit.

Guests may bring their own games equipment or play in the spacious grounds. For those looking to spend a little more, an exciting range of on-site Pay for Use activities is available, including Boda Borg, Zipit Forest Adventures, Treasure Trail, P Mac Kayaks, Lough Key Boat Tours, and Cé Saunas. Pre-booking is essential for Boda Borg and Zipit Forest Adventures. While it is not strictly necessary for other activities, ringing ahead is recommended to avoid disappointment. Dining options include a terrace and an indoor café where tables can be reserved. The park also allows customization of activities, tours, and private events for groups. The facility includes a Caravan and Camping Park and a Marina Harbour. Staying options are available nearby in the Area. The park hosts events such as the Night and Day Festival, Lough Key Legends Run, Lough Key Triathlon, and Parkrun. A swimming pool is also listed as a feature. title: The Playcentre Kingscourt: Indoor Playground & Parties
summary: Indoor playground in Kingscourt, Cavan with 5 levels, baby and toddler areas, football arena, and birthday parties.
description: The Playcentre is a purpose-built indoor play and party centre located on the Kells Road in Kingscourt, County Cavan. It is situated on the Cavan/Meath border and is rated 4.7 based on 18 reviews. The main playground area features 5 levels of fun, including a spiral slide, swings, and punchbags. There is a height restriction of 4'7" for the playground. The facility includes a dedicated Baby Area for children under 12 months of age, which is free of charge and features a sensory waterbed for tummy time and a ball pool. The Toddler Area caters to children between 1 and 3 years of age, offering a moving carousel, a flashing slide, and numerous ride-ons. A separate football arena is available for older kids and football fanatics. Adults can relax in a modern seating area overlooking the play areas, with a menu serving Italian coffees, herbal teas, fresh pastries, and an extensive hot food menu including chips, cocktail sausages, and chicken nuggets. Birthday parties last two hours, comprising 75 minutes in the play area and 45 minutes in a themed party room chosen from football, disco, or princess options. A dedicated host manages the party. Admission fees are €6 per session for ages 1-3 on weekdays and €7 on weekends, and €7 for ages 4-11 on weekdays, rising to €8 on weekends. Under 12 months is free.

title: Tearaways Pet Farm & Activity Centre
summary: Indoor and outdoor family activities in Tipperary featuring a pet farm, soft play, and party facilities.
description: Tearaways Pet Farm & Activity Centre is located in North Tipperary at Clonmona, Rathcabbin. The venue offers indoor and outdoor activities designed to keep families happy and active all year round, regardless of the weather. A key feature is the purpose-built 6,000 square foot indoor activity centre. This space includes slides, crawling tunnels, ball pits, and a separate toddler area. The indoor play structure consists of two levels with a four-lane wave slide, two tunnel slides, cargo nets, and ball pits. Please note that under 3s are not allowed to use the indoor mega slides. Visitors must wear socks, long trousers, and long sleeves to use the indoor facilities; socks can be purchased at the venue. The outdoor facilities include a Pet Farm, an outdoor playground, a sports area, a sledge run, a games area, a go-cart track, and a barrel train. The site houses many friendly animals, including goats, pigs, donkeys, alpacas, llamas, emus, sheep, calves, rabbits, and Scottish Highlanders. The venue caters to groups of all sizes for birthday parties and school tours, with special rates depending on the day of the week. For dining, there is a coffee shop where visitors can relax while children play, alongside a viewing area with comfortable seating. Various hot and cold food and drinks can be purchased. Opening hours are Saturday and Sunday from 11:00 to 18:00, and Wednesday to Sunday during school holidays. The venue is closed on Mondays and Tuesdays.

title: Beyond The Trees Avondale
summary: 1.3km treetop walk, viewing tower, historic house tours, and Ireland's first outdoor wooden marble run.
description: Beyond The Trees Avondale is located in Avondale Forest Park, Rathdrum, Co. Wicklow. The venue features a unique 1.3km treetop walk that allows visitors to journey through the forest and high above the canopy. The walk includes multiple activity stations and stories of the historic Avondale Estate. The experience culminates at a 38m high Viewing Tower offering panoramic 360-degree views of the Wicklow Mountains, the Vale of Avoca, and the Avonmore River. Visitors can return to the ground via an optional gigantic 90m spiral slide. At Home with the Parnells offers guided tours of the historic 18th Century Avondale House. These 45-minute tours take place in multiple slots every day and cover the Parnell family heritage, including Charles Stewart Parnell and the forestry school history. The venue also features Ireland's first outdoor wooden marble run, which spans 50 metres and consists of eight interconnected wooden tables designed for hands-on physics learning. A contemporary Seed Café serves locally sourced food with views of the Walled Garden. The site includes an adventurous children's playground, a sensory garden, and forest walking trails. The Treetop Walk, Viewing Tower, and Avondale House are buggy and wheelchair accessible. U18s must be accompanied by an adult, and U6s require adult supervision on the slide.

title: Michael Collins House Museum, Clonakilty
summary: Museum in Clonakilty dedicated to Michael Collins, opened in 2016, with guided tours and interactive displays.
description: Michael Collins House Museum is located at 7 Emmet Square, Clonakilty, County Cork, Ireland. It is situated in a house built in the 1800s, restored to its original era layout on a Georgian square outside Dublin. The museum, which opened in 2016, is dedicated to Michael Collins, offering insight into his life as a farmer's son, rebel, politician, and soldier, known as 'The Big Fella'. It also explores local patriots like Jeremiah O'Donovan Rossa and the history of Irish independence, including the 1798 Rebellion. The venue features interactive displays, activity sheets, audio-visual presentations, artefacts, and information boards. It is suitable for all ages and levels of interest, promoting a family-friendly atmosphere. Popular with schools and tour groups, it offers curriculum-appropriate tours, age-appropriate worksheets, and bespoke options. Guided tours last approximately one hour for groups or 1.5 hours for school groups. The museum is fully wheelchair accessible and includes baby changing facilities, toilets, and a book and gift shop. Nearby picnic areas and parks are available, with free on-street parking. Coffee, lunch, and dinner offers are available in conjunction with the Emmet Hotel. The museum is open Tuesday to Saturday from 10am to 5pm, with last admission at 4pm.

title: Glendeer Pet Farm, Athlone
summary: Irish tourist board approved pet farm in Athlone with animals, play areas, and seasonal opening times.
description: Glendeer Pet Farm is an Irish tourist board approved pet farm located in Athlone, the heart of Ireland. Since opening its gates to the public in April 1991, the farm has been featured on numerous TV programmes and won several awards. Visitors can enjoy interactive animal experiences where they can feed, pet, and hold animals including guinea pigs, chicks, lizards, tortoises, deer, pigs, llamas, alpacas, emus, goats, donkeys, and sheep. The farm also offers cute cuddle baby animals such as kid goats, lambs, and rabbits. There is something for all ages, including a double obstacle course, a maze, a zipwire, a soft play toddler area, and a sand barn with diggers. An 1850s restored cottage and a secluded Fairy Trail are also available. The venue is suitable for any weather with indoor play areas and a large section of animals housed undercover. Facilities include a coffee shop, indoor and outdoor picnic areas, a children's playground, pets corner, toilets, baby changing facilities, a souvenir shop, and ample parking. The farm is wheelchair accessible and caters to groups with additional needs. Opening times run from March 16th to the end of September, closed on Tuesdays and Wednesdays in March, April, and May (excluding Easter Mid Term). Regular hours are Monday to Saturday from 11am to 6pm, and Sunday from 12pm to 6pm.
